mapper.select: select TEMP.* from ( SELECT A.FINPROD_ID as finprodId, A.FINPROD_TYPE as finprodType, A.BRANCH as branch, A.TRADE_ID as tradeId, A.CCY as ccy, A.TRADE_AMT as tradeAmt, A.PS as ps, A.TRADE_STATUS as tradeStatus, if(fin.P_FINPROD_ID=null,fin.FINPROD_ID, null) as proId, D.TASK_ID as taskId, D.BOOKSET_ID as booksetId, D.BOOKSET_DATE as booksetDate, D.HAPPEN_DATE as happenDate, D.BOOK_DATE as bookDate, M.STANDARD_CCY as standardCcy FROM BOK_BATCH_TASK_TODO D INNER JOIN BOK_BOOKSET M ON D.BOOKSET_ID = M.BOOKSET_ID INNER JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING B ON ( D.BOOKSET_ID = B.BOOKSET_ID AND D.HAPPEN_DATE = B.HAPPEN_DATE AND D.BOOK_DATE = B.BOOK_DATE ) INNER JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL A ON ( B.BUSI_NO = A.TRADE_ID AND (A.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType1} or A.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType2} or A.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType3}) ) LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fin ON A.FINPROD_ID = fin.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD ext ON ext.FINPROD_ID = fin.FINPROD_ID WHERE D.SEQ_NO = #{seqNo} AND D.BOOK_DATE = #{BOOK_DATE,jdbcType=DATE} AND D.HAPPEN_DATE = #{HAPPEN_DATE,jdbcType=DATE} AND D.BOOKSET_DATE = #{BOOKSET_DATE,jdbcType=DATE} AND D.TASK_ID = #{taskId} AND ext.PROFIT_FLAG = #{profitFlag} )TEMP
